name: Ichikawa Sumika
source:
Sumika is the manager of "Platinum: Oceanside" and also [url=https://vndb.org/c60294]Kazuma[/url]'s ex-girlfriend. She dumped him after college because she didn't think he was serious enough about her, but now, she's the one that doesn't mind having a little fun with him. She's also married. Is she really just that casual about sex, or does she have some buried feelings for her ex-lover?

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582992-do-you-like-horny-bunnies-2/faqs/34122]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
